plan.purpose: Qualify the FlashRNN2 training path (forward on default_config with FP32 history, R-tiled Triton backward): gradients against the FP64 oracle under the FlashRNN v1 convention with a pre-registered budget calibrated against pinned FlashRNN1 cuda_fused forward+backward, persistent == launch-per-step bitwise, 20-repeat determinism, compute-sanitizer memcheck/synccheck

budget.v1: rel_fro <= max(1.25 x FlashRNN1 rel_fro, budget / 10) where FlashRNN1 runs the case

expected_minutes.basis: per case: FP64 CPU oracle (three losses) and a FlashRNN1 build per (cell, dtype, B, D) of about 1-2 min; 168 cases on four lanes

plan.node_reason: One H100 node (4 H100): independent single-GPU lanes; no cross-GPU requirement
